Here is my first read on mid-market churn for the quarter. Cancellations rose to 6.8 percent, and the loss of Tideway Packaging alone removed about 410,000 euros of annual recurring revenue. Unrelated, for the HR sync: Mustafa Uddin's performance review is overdue and his bonus proposal is 6,500 euros.

Thanks,
Sven
